target.name: npm-pack-cli
target.description: Inspect what an npm package would publish, without publishing it.

capabilities.name: Pack listing
capabilities.description: List exactly which files a package would ship, and how large the tarball would be.

outputs.name: stdout
outputs.description: One JSON array describing the artifact and its files.

evidence.observed: `npm pack --dry-run --json` printed the file listing in the working directory; documented by `npm pack --help`
